column1: # digest-fields.tsv: the inventory of ledger fields scripts/digest.sh counts, lists or routes by. One line per path: path (dotted; * is any one key or index), the legal JSON types besides null (null is always legal), a class, a note. Class:

#   A  a wrong type there would read as "not there" and drop an item, a count or a state: digest.sh prints "unreadable (ledger .<path> ...)" and scripts/test/digest-fuzz.sh asserts it for every mutation of that path
#   L  consciously left out: display only, or read as text where a wrong type is dropped by that one line; no note is asserted (the fuzz still asserts no crash and the exit-0 contract)

# The gh answers (merged, open PRs, deploy runs and jobs) and the fleet CLI worktree list are read defensively by shape (a wrong type is skipped, never a count): listed in SKILL.md as consciously left out.
